selected.lesson_subject: Static virtual IPs: DNAT mapping, port forwarding and ARP ownership
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: WAN packet to external VIP -> DNAT extip/port mapping -> firewall policy references VIP -> route to mapped server -> reply path/NAT
selected.failure_class: VIP ARP ownership steals traffic, wrong extintf/port mapping, VIP not referenced by policy, or central-NAT configuration location mismatch
selected.evidence_pattern: VIP configuration, packet sniffer before/after DNAT, policy hit counter and server-side reply; VIP object existence alone does not prove a matching policy
selected.remediation_path: validate extip/extintf/mappedip/portforward and ARP reply, reference VIP in the correct policy, account for central NAT UI location and remove unused VIPs

selected.lesson_subject: Normalized interfaces with per-device and per-platform mapping
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: ADOM normalized-interface object -> platform mapping and device/VDOM mapping -> shared policy reference -> install-time resolution -> target CLI interface/zone
selected.failure_class: missing/default mapping, wrong device/VDOM binding, or interface-name mismatch at installation
selected.evidence_pattern: normalized-interface mapping table plus install preview/generated target interface; policy reference alone does not prove target interface resolved
selected.remediation_path: check ADOM, default mapping, model/platform mapping and per-device override; preview install before commit

selected.lesson_subject: FortiGate onboarding through Security Fabric authorization
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FAZ Fabric Authorization address/port -> FortiGate Logging & Analytics connector -> unauthorized state -> administrator credential approval -> authorized Device Manager entry -> separate log transport
selected.failure_class: authorization endpoint/port mismatch, connector disabled, credential rejection, or authorization completed without log transport
selected.evidence_pattern: FortiGate connector status and FAZ authorized-device state prove trust enrollment; log receipt and Analytics indexing are separate later boundaries
selected.remediation_path: verify authorization address/port, connector enablement, reachability, certificate/API settings and approval; then separately test OFTP/log ingestion

selected.lesson_subject: IGMP snooping, proxy, querier and static multicast membership
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: host IGMP report -> per-VLAN/group snooping entry -> mRouter/querier refresh -> multicast forwarding to listener ports -> aging/leave
selected.failure_class: missing querier, stale group entry, wrong mRouter port, unknown-multicast flood policy, or IGMP version mismatch
selected.evidence_pattern: learned group/port table, querier state, mRouter role and age timer; VLAN membership alone does not prove listener learning
selected.remediation_path: confirm IGMP reports reach switch, enable valid querier when needed, tune aging above query interval, inspect unknown-multicast behavior and IGMP version

selected.lesson_subject: Airtime fairness using per-SSID downlink weights
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: SSID/VAP atf-weight assignment -> AP downlink airtime scheduler -> weighted airtime allocation among VAPs -> client throughput outcome
selected.failure_class: expecting uplink fairness, applying weight to wrong SSID/radio, or interpreting throughput as a strict byte-rate guarantee
selected.evidence_pattern: VAP/profile atf-weight and controlled downlink airtime/throughput comparison; client RSSI or aggregate throughput alone does not prove scheduler weighting
selected.remediation_path: enable Advanced Wireless Features, configure intended VAP weight and radio support, compare simultaneous downlink load under controlled RF conditions

selected.lesson_subject: Guest self-registration with sponsor approval and expiring accounts
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: guest isolation redirect -> self-registration request -> sponsor/request-pool approval -> template account creation -> credential delivery -> login -> production access
selected.failure_class: request expiry, sponsor profile/email misconfiguration, template/account-duration mismatch, or approval bypass setting
selected.evidence_pattern: pending request, sponsor action, guest account/template/expiry and post-login host/VLAN state; approval alone does not prove production access
selected.remediation_path: validate sponsor administrator profile and email, portal sponsor routing, GuestSelfRegistration template, account duration and downstream access policy

selected.lesson_subject: Manual LDAP user import and explicit host association
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: LDAP connection and user-DN read -> User Accounts Add New/Loaded from Directory -> assign role -> associate user with host record -> policy identity context
selected.failure_class: directory read succeeds but user record/role/host relationship is incomplete or User ID does not match directory identity
selected.evidence_pattern: Loaded from Directory, user record fields/role, and host association; successful LDAP bind alone does not prove user is linked to endpoint
selected.remediation_path: confirm LDAP user DN readability, import user without requiring group import, assign appropriate role and explicitly associate correct host

selected.lesson_subject: EAP-TTLS two-factor authentication: challenge-flow and FortiAuthenticator 8.0.4 compatibility boundary
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: IKEv2 EAP client -> EAP-TTLS TLS tunnel -> inner credential -> RADIUS policy/realm -> password+OTP concatenation on legacy builds or challenge-based OTP on 8.0.4+ -> RADIUS result
selected.failure_class: version-specific OTP flow mismatch, EAP method/policy/realm mismatch, or TLS certificate trust failure
selected.evidence_pattern: correlated FortiAuthenticator RADIUS log and client EAP error plus exact FAC/FortiOS/FortiClient versions; a direct LDAP test does not prove the EAP inner factor flow
selected.remediation_path: identify exact build; for pre-8.0.4 use documented concatenation behavior; from 8.0.4 follow challenge-based EAP-TTLS policy behavior; validate client and FortiOS minimum versions

selected.lesson_subject: Certificate-based SSH authentication for SSH-key secrets and expiry alerts
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: SSH-key secret template -> select public-key-with-certificate -> store credential/certificate validity -> launcher uses secret -> expiry status/email alert lifecycle
selected.failure_class: wrong SSH-key template/type, expired or not-yet-valid certificate, target trust mismatch, or alert configuration missing
selected.evidence_pattern: secret public-key type and certificate details/validity status plus launcher result and expiry notification; secret existence does not prove target accepts certificate
selected.remediation_path: verify SSH-key template, selected certificate public key, validity window, target-side trust and Certificate email-alert settings

selected.lesson_subject: External authentication profiles and organization-scoped user authentication
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: external auth profile -> protocol/server/certificate settings -> test credentials -> bind profile to CMDB user and organization -> login -> role/tenant authorization
selected.failure_class: profile connection/TLS name validation, incorrect organization binding, or authentication success without correct FortiSIEM role
selected.evidence_pattern: profile test and user profile binding followed by login/role/organization visibility; successful LDAP bind does not prove correct FortiSIEM authorization
selected.remediation_path: validate protocol, host/port, certificate CN/SAN and Base DN, select correct organization, bind profile to user and verify role

selected.lesson_subject: External threat feeds synchronized from FortiManager into Web Filter and DNS Filter
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiManager threat feed -> Web/DNS profile reference -> central-management sync -> FortiSASE feed import/refresh -> profile category or traffic policy enforcement
selected.failure_class: feed not referenced by supported profile, unsupported category range/limit, credentials not synchronized, or sync/refresh stale
selected.evidence_pattern: FortiManager profile reference, FortiSASE feed entry list and central-management sync log; feed card alone does not prove active policy enforcement
selected.remediation_path: reference feed from Web/DNS profile before sync, configure HTTP basic-auth credentials directly in FortiSASE, respect 21 DNS/Web category feed limit and verify sync details

selected.lesson_subject: Underlay-bandwidth-aware load balancing across overlay members
selected.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: underlay/overlay members and estimated bandwidth -> load-balance SD-WAN service -> directional bandwidth hash -> eligible member selection -> session forwarding
selected.failure_class: service still uses overlay bandwidth by default, missing member estimates, wrong hash direction or ties mistaken for per-packet striping
selected.evidence_pattern: diagnose sys sdwan service output with hash mode, bandwidth-type, member available-bandwidth values and selected members; tunnel up alone does not prove capacity-based selection
selected.remediation_path: configure member bandwidth estimates, enable service load balancing, choose inbandwidth/outbandwidth/bibandwidth and set bandwidth-type underlay; verify selection with controlled traffic
